title: LightWallet
tagline: LightWallet is designed to empower the visually impaired by granting them seamless and direct access to their crypto wallets through voice commands.
description: Through the voice control of Lightwallet, visually impaired people will be able to check wallet amounts, transfer money to friends, swap, and other functions. In particular, the swap function is a unique innovation in the web3 wallet. At the same time, we support Metamask, worldcoin, walletconnect, uniswap, and other platforms. LightWallet will open a door to web3 for the visually impaired.
how_its_made:
Main Tech: Solidty, react, AI model, Automatic Speech Recognition(ASR), etc.

In the first step, we integrate speech recognition technology and AI models.
The second step is to drive the wallet operation through voiceprint matching.
In the third step, the user gives voice commands to operate the wallet to perform actions.
